name: tangent
description: Type a question between pipes mid-sentence: a space after the closing pipes asks Haiku in the background and writes the answer back into your draft.

open.title: Opening delimiter
open.description: Extra opening delimiter, 2+ characters, no letters or spaces (e.g. ;;; or [[). Added next to the built-in pairs and any added with /tangent delims add.

close.title: Closing delimiter
close.description: Custom closing delimiter. Empty means the same as the opening one.
